summary: Restore an acceptable service state using an authorized, data-compatible recovery action.

inputs.name: deployment-record
inputs.description: Observed deployment identity, revision, environment, and phase.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Requested outcome, scope, constraints, and operating limits.

inputs.name: release-plan
inputs.description: Immutable release identity, target, preconditions, rollout, and recovery controls.

inputs.name: release-observation
inputs.description: Revision-specific post-deployment evidence and operational verdict.

inputs.name: incident-record
inputs.description: Current impact, incident timeline, mitigations, and evidence.

inputs.name: migration-plan
inputs.description: Compatibility phases, data invariants, validation, and recovery procedure.

completion_checks: The selected recovery is compatible with current data and has explicit authority and stop conditions.
Service state, revision, data invariants, and remaining impact are observed after the action.
failure_modes: Missing required inputs, capability, or authority: blocked; retain a concrete next action.
Contradictory or insufficient evidence: inconclusive; never report an unobserved outcome as passed.
A demonstrated violation of a required condition: failed; preserve reproducible evidence.

conditional_effects.condition: Recovery requires restoring or modifying live data and the host explicitly selects this effect for the invocation.
